lines.line: Immersion water heater rod — 1000W, budget ISI
lines.note: Only the unlabelled ~Rs350 rod (04AZ, 12 sold) moves; the SKU named 1000 Watt is dead and none in stock.

lines.line: Immersion water heater rod — 1500W, branded shockproof
lines.best_match: Shine Star Immersion Water Heater 1500 Watt
lines.note: Also a 2000W rod (08E2, q8, stk13) — the rod line is the live part of the heating shelf.

lines.line: Bucket / immersion heater with thermostat + auto cut-off (safety SKU)
lines.note: 12 immersion rod/heater SKUs, none with a thermostat or auto cut-off; only thermometers hit 'thermo'.

lines.line: Electric kettle — 1.5L stainless steel, mass value
lines.note: The 1.5L Prestige SKU is dead; 1.8-2.0L value kettles carry the line (28 kettle SKUs, 11 selling).

lines.line: Electric kettle — 1.5-1.8L branded, concealed element, auto cut-off
lines.note: Havells trio sells thin but real; Prestige/Kent/Pringle branded kettles never sold.
Only the 1L Shinestar sold (5 units); the 1.0L and 500ml SKUs are dead and nothing is in stock.

lines.line: Multi-purpose cooking kettle (noodle/soup kettle, steel bowl)
lines.note: Skyline Multi Cooker 3-in-1 and Multi Cooking Pan are the genuine matches; neither sold in 12m.
All 28 kettle SKUs are steel/plastic; no glass or temperature-control kettle exists.

lines.line: Commercial tea / water urn — 10-20L electric boiler
lines.note: Largest kettle is 2.5L; 'boil' returns zero products. No institutional urn in the catalogue.

lines.line: Electric milk boiler / milk cooker with auto cut-off
lines.note: Every cooker SKU is a stovetop pressure cooker; no milk boiler of any kind.
No egg boiler; 'egg' only hits eggless mayonnaise and veggie snacks.
Unlabelled budget irons (Prince 038O q10, Denim 01S0, Prince 038R) outsell the wattage-marked ones and are in stock.
Bajaj 1000W is the anchor (11 in stock); Havells 1000W also sells, Syska/Usha 1000W dead.
Three genuine steam irons listed (Philips GC1905, Prestige, Aries); none sold in 12m, none in stock.

lines.line: Steam iron — 2000W+ premium, vertical steam / steam burst
lines.note: Only sub-1500W steam irons are listed and all are dead; no 2000W+ premium SKU exists at all.
Small but live: 4 portable + 1 hand steamer sold, 2 in stock.

lines.line: Ironing board + iron accessories (sole cleaner, cover, cord)
lines.note: 33 iron SKUs but zero boards, sole cleaners, covers or appliance cords — the attach sale is unstocked.
Only 450-500W nutri/juicer units move, 1-2 pcs each; the shelf is technically alive but paper-thin.
15+ mixer-grinder SKUs incl. Philips/Inalsa 3-jar; not one family-size unit sold in 12m or in stock.
Sujata Powermatic Plus and Bhagwati Dynamix are listed but have never sold; nothing in stock.

lines.line: Mixer spares — jars, couplers, blades, gaskets, brushes
lines.note: Only two Sujata mixi jars (both dead); no couplers, blades, gaskets or carbon brushes at all.
11 hand-blender SKUs but only one unit sold in 12m; 4 pcs sit in stock.
One electric chopper, 1 sold, out of stock; the other choppers (Pigeon, Rk, Blaze) are manual pull-cord.

lines.line: Electric hand mixer / egg beater / dough kneader attachment
lines.note: The 'Hand Mixer' SKUs are Rs85-class manual beaters; nothing electric. Only a Rs217 Coffee Beater sells.
Prestige (5 sold) plus Havells 1600W and Kent 1200W; live and partly in stock.
Shine Star 2000W is the only wattage-confirmed unit; Skyline/Pigeon prices fit the band.

lines.best_match: Dev Bhumi Cooker 2 Ltr Induction Base
lines.note: Only induction-base pressure cookers sell; no induction kadai/tawa has ever moved.

lines.line: Infrared / radiant hot plate cooktop (works with any vessel)
lines.note: Three genuine hot plates (Apollo 2000W/1250W, Utility 500W); all q0 and out of stock.
All 20+ cooker SKUs are stovetop pressure cookers; no electric rice cooker exists.
Skyline Multi Cooker 3-in-1 is the only electric-cooker-shaped SKU and it has never sold.
One toaster sold (Rs975); the Shinestar 1000W griller has 4 pcs in stock but no sales.
Only a microwave (0FE7, 1 sold) and an electric tandoor (0FE6); no OTG in the catalogue.
'Air Fryer' only matches McCain frozen snacks; no air-fryer appliance.

lines.line: Fan heater / room blower — 1000-2000W, 2 heat settings
lines.note: Room heaters sell well (24+13 units) but names never say blower vs rod; the one explicit Fan Heater is dead.
No SKU names quartz/halogen; the generic Rs950-1,810 room heaters that sell cover this price band.

lines.line: PTC ceramic fan heater with thermostat
lines.note: Zero PTC or ceramic heaters; the safe-heater option for babies/elderly does not exist here.
None of the 22 heater SKUs is an oil-filled radiator.
'Compac Heat Converter' reads as a convector heater — the only candidate, never sold.

lines.line: Electric blanket / bed warmer — single and double
lines.note: 'Heating Sheet' (Electricals) is the only electric bedding SKU and it has never sold; ordinary blankets do.

lines.line: Rechargeable electro-thermal hot water bag / hand warmer
lines.note: 06TG (Rs269, 38 sold, 12 in stock) is almost certainly the electric bag; rubber bottles are listed separately.

lines.line: Electric heating pad / orthopaedic heat belt
lines.note: No heating pad or heat belt; 'ortho' hits only pain-relief oils.
Zero geysers of any type; immersion rods are the only hot-water product ARY sells.
No storage geyser; the whole geyser category is absent from 21,479 SKUs.

lines.line: Geyser & heater spares — element, thermostat, anode rod, capillary
lines.note: Elements/spare rods sell hard (63 units, 16 in stock); no thermostats, anode rods or capillaries.
Only 2 table fans, 3 units each, both out of stock — a token presence, not a season buy.
Six fan SKUs in total and none is a wall-mount — the standard hostel/canteen fit is unstocked.
'pedestal' returns zero products.
Two ceiling-fan SKUs, 2 units sold, none in stock and no BLDC option.
'exhaust' returns zero products; no ventilation fan for damp bathrooms or mess kitchens.

lines.line: Rechargeable / USB fan (power-cut and hostel fan)
lines.note: The only rechargeable items are torches and one light; no rechargeable or USB fan.
Skyline is the only live dryer (7 sold, 8 in stock); 7 other dryer SKUs have never sold.
No dryer SKU names wattage; every non-entry dryer is dead and the one seller averages Rs813.

lines.line: Hair styler / straightener / dryer-brush (adjacent grooming electrical)
lines.note: Two straighteners listed (Vega 3-in-1 and a generic); neither sold, neither in stock.
Havells 20W inverter bulb sells (4 units, 1 in stock); the Syska 7W emergency bulb is dead.

lines.line: Rechargeable LED emergency lantern / tube light
lines.note: Shine Star Rechargable Light is the only lantern-type SKU and has never sold; torches take the demand.
Eveready torches are live (13+6+6+6 units) with stock; no headlamp or search light though.

lines.line: Extension boards, multi-plugs, plug tops, appliance cords, fuses
lines.note: Boards, plug tops and sockets all sell and stock; no appliance cords or fuses listed.
No stabilizer of any brand — nothing protects the mixers and geysers sold here from hill voltage swings.

lines.line: Room cooler / air cooler (low priority — carry token depth only)
lines.note: Only 'China Fan Mini Cooler', never sold — consistent with the line's own advice to carry near-zero.
